text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho...! Spring...! Ah, what a 
truly majestic ring to it!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"The brilliant first stage of the Senior 
Year that I've been aiming for. Don't you 
think it suits me perfectly?"
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's a prestigious race after all.
Yeah, it's a prestigious race, after all.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"‘Authority.’ Yes, if there is one single 
thing I am currently lacking, it would 
be—"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That would be 'authority.' Even if someone 
has the strength of an overlord, there are 
always those unwilling to acknowledge a 
newcomer.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
By running well in traditional races, I'll 
gain prestige and establish the brand that 
is Me!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Only then will those stubborn, 
old-fashioned traditionalists finally 
acknowledge it.
choice_data_list: You've got a lot on your plate.
It's tough dealing with all that, huh?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but that's part of the thrill of 
being the "Overlord."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Beyond this Tenno Sho (Spring), a 
decisive battle against Doto and the 
heroes of the previous era awaits. 
However..."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Today, there is only one rival. An 
invisible enemy known as 'Authority'!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
However, as the one who will become the 
"End of the Century Overlord," I shall not 
be fazed.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, watch closely. Allow me to take this 
finicky old fellow by the hand and show 
you a magnificent dance!

T.M. Opera O strides into the paddock with 
a majestic, dignified presence...

Whether one is a true king or not— will be 
put to the test on this stage rich with 
tradition!
